rows.basis: Della asks the shop owner whether she will buy her hair.
The shop owner names the price she will pay for Della’s hair.
Della tells the owner to cut her hair quickly.

rows.text: “Please let him still think I’m pretty,”
rows.context: “Please let him still think I’m pretty,” she whispered.
rows.basis: Della whispers her hope that Jim will still think she is pretty.

rows.text: “I sold it, Jim. I couldn’t let Christmas come without giving you something. It’ll grow again!”
rows.context: “I sold it, Jim. I couldn’t let Christmas come without giving you something. It’ll grow again!”
rows.basis: Della explains to Jim that she sold her hair to buy him a gift.
Della says her hair will grow back.

rows.text: “Look! Isn’t it perfect? Give me your watch.”
rows.context: “Look! Isn’t it perfect? Give me your watch.”
rows.basis: Della shows Jim the chain and asks him for his watch.

rows.text: “I sold the watch to buy your combs.”
rows.context: “I sold the watch to buy your combs.”
rows.basis: Jim explains that he sold his watch to buy Della’s combs.
